Author: kittenhaswares-ui
Name: Seiton Sense
Punchline: PvP pressure, isolation, defensive/reactive utilities, assists, and target clarity.
Description: A local PvP HUD integrating pressure and CC-protection cues, an urgent isolation warning, native-HUD resource auras, Ninja Seiton cues and a default-off fresh-key helper, fail-closed macro assistance, defensive/reactive utilities and team-visible focus marking, and target highlights.
Changelog: Adds a default-off, fresh-key Ninja Seiton helper in Crystalline Conflict. It selects the lowest exact HP ratio among canonical S1-S5 enemies that are strictly below 50% and natively reachable, then freezes that one intent. It requires verified readiness, no own Guard, and an unclaimed shared input generation. State is consumed before one attempt, with no target mutation, second selection, alternate, fallback, or retry. Configuration schema 19 keeps the helper off for new, upgraded, and reset settings.
